def strip_first_component(
    member: tarfile.TarInfo,
    path: object,
) -> tarfile.TarInfo:
    _, member.name = member.name.split('/', 1)
    return member


_default_filter = _compose_tarfile_filters(tarfile.data_filter, strip_first_component)  # type: ignore[no-untyped-call]
